notes: ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED (CC BY 2.0, Flickr original 48388967401 by Steve Lynes). RCAF CP-140M Aurora 140112 (405/407 Sqn grey, 'RCAF ARC' roundel, Canadian flag and '140112' on the fin) in flight at the Royal International Air Tattoo, RAF Fairford, 22 Jul 2019. Left 3/4 view from slightly below, NOSE LEFT, gear up, all four propellers turning (blurred blades), whole aircraft incl. MAD tail boom; plain overcast white sky. No sharp PD/OGL photo of a CP-140 in flight exists on Commons (the PD RIMPAC 2024 frames are 1000 px landing/taxi shots; the CC BY 2.0 USCG Op Nanook 2021 fly-by over Nuuk is motion-blurred), so this CC BY photo was used. Original 5524x3779 (kept as assets-src/tmp-air/orig/cp140_riat.jpg) cropped to box 150,1050,5450,2600 and downscaled to 3200x936 (PIL Lanczos, JPEG q95) = photos/cp140.jpg. Canva remove-background + layer design exported as transparent lossless PNG 3200x936 (pro); final = Canva alpha + photo RGB (scripts/alpha_cutout.py: 1 component, 488 hole px filled). LOCAL FIX: Canva kept the two HF antenna wires (wing to fin top) as 6-10 px bands of light sky, which read as white webbing; they were removed with assets-src/tmp-air/scripts/remove_thin.py (opening, kernel 13 px, box 1770,95,2412,428, pad 48) plus erase_poly.py on the wire junction at the fin leading edge (polygon 2350,128 2418,128 2397,167 2350,167); the pre-fix file is assets-src/tmp-air/cp140_final_before_wirefix.png. Two tiny wire-attachment knobs remain on the wing trailing edge (real parts, a few px). The blurred propeller blades are light grey (sky shows through the blur) and merge into the paper border as lobes; that is the photo, not a cut error. Subject bbox 3004x784. Sticker 1471x437. Checked at 640 px wide over the grid at 1x and 2x: complete, no webbing, markings identical to the photo. In P2S19 it sits on the LEFT facing left while p8 faces right (they point away from each other); do not mirror either sticker (lettering). Verification pass 3: sticker re-made with --fill-paper 60, which only closes a 50 px pinhole in the paper between the blurred blades of the inner left propeller (sticker px ~476,109; it showed as a dark slot) and a 1 px thin spot near the lower-left propeller; the cutout itself is unchanged.
